scenarios.title: A solved static ability applies only while the Case is solved

setup.notes: Case of the Gateway Express is solved in the base: 'Solved - Creatures you control get +1/+0.' Its enters trigger has already been resolved on an earlier turn.

decisions: No action is taken; the power and toughness of Grizzly Bears are read on the stable board.

scenarios.title: A solved triggered ability triggers only if the Case is solved

setup.notes: Case of the Crimson Pulse is solved in the base: 'Solved - At the beginning of your upkeep, discard your hand, then draw two cards.' A's library is listed top card first.

decisions: The upkeep of A begins. If the Case's ability triggers, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: solved
variants.expected: The Case's triggered ability triggers. Shock and Mountain are discarded to A's graveyard and A draws two Mountains from the library.

variants.label: unsolved
variants.expected: The Case's ability does not trigger. A's hand is still Shock and Mountain, the graveyard is empty and the library is unchanged.

scenarios.title: A solved activated ability can be activated only if the Case is solved

setup.notes: Case of the Stashed Skeleton is solved in the base: 'Solved - {1}{B}, Sacrifice this Case: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.' The stack is empty.

decisions: A considers activating the Case's ability, paying {1}{B} with both Swamps and sacrificing the Case.

variants.label: unsolved
variants.expected: Activating the ability is not legal.
